problem: A fresh recovery critic proved five concrete safety gaps in the current lease/recovery canary: READ_ONLY_RECOVERY can bypass retryable=false; unknown overlap can collapse to false; stale generations have no deterministic one-winner recovery execution fence; a bare recovery attempt can count as liveness; and generated recovery-claim schema diverges from persisted recovery claims. Live Kernel evidence then showed multiple recovery claims for the same stale generation, so this is now an observed canary problem rather than a hypothetical one.
acceptance: Unknown overlap state fails closed and requires an evidence receipt before recovery execution.
Concurrent recovery attempts for one stale generation yield one execution winner while preserving losing append-only evidence.
A recovery claim/attempt without STARTED or heartbeat does not refresh worker liveness.
Builder/scanner output is canonical with or explicitly adapts to prometeo.opportunity-recovery-claim/v1.
Targeted regression tests cover F1-F5 and preserve late-return reconciliation semantics.
title: Repair recovery fencing and proof semantics
mission: Produce a preserve-first Lease/Retry follow-up candidate that closes the critic-proven F1-F5 recovery safety gaps, adds deterministic one-winner fencing for a stale generation, and proves the repaired semantics with targeted regression/race tests without promoting production /w or mutating Current/Human Accepted/Served authority.

incident_repair.reason: The independent recovery critic marked F1-F3 BLOCKING and F4-F5 HIGH, and live Kernel recovery produced multiple claims for the same stale generation minutes later.

unblock_value.reason: Recovery safety is part of the universal-worker success contract and remains a production /w blocker until independently repaired and stress-verified.

regression_prevention.reason: The existing 11-case suite passed while the critic still found five material gaps; explicit adversarial regression cases are required to prevent green tests from masking unsafe takeover semantics.

human_friction_reduction.reason: Deterministic recovery fencing prevents duplicate rescuers from requiring manual reconciliation when many identical worker chats are launched.

falsification: Two rescuers can both acquire execution authority for one stale generation.
retryable=false still allows any recovery mode to execute substantive retry work.
Missing overlap proof is serialized as NO_ACTIVE_OVERLAP rather than UNKNOWN/PARK.
A recovery claim without STARTED/heartbeat delays later stale detection by refreshing liveness.
Scanner/builder output cannot round-trip or adapt to the persisted prometeo.opportunity-recovery-claim/v1 schema.
Late original RETURN is discarded or silently overwritten after recovery starts.
dedup_note: This is the exact follow-up owner named by the completed O-SWARM-CRITIC-RECOVERY-V1 return. No existing proposal pin with this canonical root/target/problem/acceptance fingerprint was present at prewrite; the pin was then won through create-if-absent after one unrelated moving-main 409 retry. This proposal does not compete with Kernel recovery or stress verification; it repairs the shared Lease/Retry mechanism they depend on.
